summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a Go binary that opens a remote shell to relay.sextant.top and harvests Anthropic API keys
details: The package ships a single Darwin/amd64 Go binary at bin/sxt. The binary links github.com/creack/pty (PTY spawning) and github.com/coder/websocket, with a hardcoded destination wss://relay.sextant.top and a WebRTC data-channel path via github.com/pion/webrtc, providing an interactive remote shell on the installer's host controlled by that endpoint. The same binary contains the Anthropic API key regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}, references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and calls https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models (the vendor key-validation endpoint), so discovered keys are validated against Anthropic before being sent onward. It also queries http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query for installer geolocation and beacons https://relay.sextant.top/install on registration. The package.json license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, matching the observed remote-control and Claude-key-harvesting behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
